The careful twin is route-b. Re-sited 2026-10-19 (Waymark, brief 023; engine 0.8.2 crowd.pace strings walkers out along a leg): the kill is timed to 73's arrival, not pinned to a tick (the composer takes the first tick he is in reach, searched every 0.5 s), at a spot a finder passes: on the square north of the Office, where nobody sees the act and the records-office guards walking back to the Office pass within witness range at about 7:35. Played on 0.8.2: the kill at 4:29.8 is unseen; his missed 5:30 mark is Alert 1; guard 64 (p-records-office-64) finds him at 7:35.2 and radios it in, nobody stopping him (the Enforcer is walking Vale to the car), landing at 7:40.2 after the Take: Alert 2, a unit sent; the car leaves at 7:58.5. A win at Alert 2 and 3 T plus 6 T carried into the campaign and an open case (12 T in total at case-trail-eq 3) against route B's 3 T at Alert 0: MC-7 counts it worse, not failed. At the car the whole cell boards (the seal clock may run, so anyone left standing would be captured).
